description: The Quick Trip: Start + squares 1-100 + END (101), built from the best-working events of the long board (data/board-long.json), thinned out, not compressed (step I-5, owner approved the event list and numbers in I-5.1). Every rule field is identical to the long board except the forks (crossroads 41 and 80, halved Shortcuts). The approved long-board story (step I-5.3: every text reused) is in 'story' and 'icon' per square and in 'story' for the rule elements. 'text' keeps the paper's original words; destinations are the short-board squares.

7.story: Ankle-deep puddle. Next turn: one careful step.

10.story: A farmer offers a lift. Don't overthink it.

15.story: The Bog. Your shoes live here now. Roll a 6.

17.story: Hay cart to the forest. Not glamorous, but fast.

20.story: Hot-air balloon. See you at the river!

30.text: Bonus card: once, whenever you like - avoid one of your punishments OR cancel a reward of another player
30.story: A kind stranger slips you a Bonus card.

32.text: Go to nearest reward and do it
32.story: A local knows a shortcut: next good square!

37.text: Change place with the player closest to END
37.story: Plot twist! Swap places with the leader.

40.story: Cable car to the Mountain Lodge. Window seat!

45.story: Bog boots. Mud? Never heard of it.

49.story: Riverbank selfie. Slipped. Straight into the Bog.

54.text: Get some vacation, go to hotel
54.story: Spontaneous weekend off. Straight to the Mountain Lodge.

61.story: Sledge run! Throw three times, add them all up.

66.story: Lodge booking? What booking? Back to Base Camp.

69.text: Follow the snake - become Snake Leader
69.story: A sea snake gives you a lift. Snake Leader!

72.text: The other players double what they throw
72.story: Ice cream break. Everyone else doubles their next throw.

74.story: Wrong ferry. All the way back to the Bog.

79.story: Wrong snake. This one goes all the way back.

91.text: Car was stolen, go to police 97 - no prison
91.story: Fell asleep on the train. Woke up at the river.

94.story: Missed your stop. Back to the seaside.

96.story: Forgot your keys! Back to Central Station.

99.text: Forgot keys again, back to work 184 and skip two turns
99.story: Forgot your keys AGAIN!!! Back to Central Station, wait two turns.

100.text: Snake Leader only: follow the snake back to 165
100.story: Snake Leader? The snake wants its ride back. Down you go.

rulesNote: rules = FROZEN set (GCD R1-R21) as on the long board. Changed for the half-length board (owner, I-5.1): forks (crossroads 41 -> roads meet at 48, Shortcut 6 squares, square 1 -> 50, square 2 -> Bog 15; crossroads 80 -> roads meet at 90, Shortcut 9 squares, square 1 -> 92, square 3 -> Bog 15). Fallen tree unchanged (back 10, range 10).

start.name: Home
start.story: Bags packed. Roll a 6 to leave.

end.name: Festival of Lights
end.story: Festival of Lights! You made it. Light your lanterns!

start.name: Porch steps
start.story: No 6? Still on the porch. One more step.
start.picture: wooden steps beside the front door, one added per failed throw

trap.name: Stepping stones
trap.story: No 6? Another stone. The mud is patient.
trap.picture: stones in the mud from 15 towards 16, one added per failed throw

lifelines.name: Lanterns
lifelines.lose: Three throws, no 6. A lantern flickers out.
lifelines.win: Three 6s in a row. Lantern back on!
lifelines.none: Attention! You have no lanterns left…
lifelines.out: Lights out. Your journey ends here.

roadblock.name: Fallen tree
roadblock.story: Fallen tree. Nobody's moving it. Back ten squares.

safe.name: Main Road
safe.story: The Main Road. Boring, but it works.

bonus.name: Bonus card
bonus.story: Cancel a punishment for yourself, or a reward for another player. Once.

jailPass.name: Bog boots
jailPass.story: Bog boots. Mud? Never heard of it.

snakeLeader.name: Snake Leader
snakeLeader.story: Snake Leader: you rode the snake. It remembers.
